function: F-10.2 — Establish and confirm active UAV control: command the takeover and give the pilot assurance that the UAV is now under their authority (connection established + confirmation received).
function_summary: Establish UAV control and confirm pilot authority.
behaviour: Be-10.2.1 (Touch-only): pilot taps COMMAND TAKEOVER on the acknowledged/armed takeover panel with tap-to-select + tap-to-CONFIRM dual gate; connection progress (requesting→authorized→established) rendered on panel; established-confirmation on notification strip. Be-10.2.2 (Keyboard-only): pilot uses bezel OSS/UCP to select COMMAND TAKEOVER and a second discrete press to CONFIRM; same progress rendering and confirmation cue; fully completable without touch. Be-10.2.3 (Mixed): pilot selects via one modality (Touch) and confirms via the other (bezel OSS) or vice versa, sharing the same armed/committed state; adds turbulence/high-vibration resilience.
behaviour_summary: Dual-gate command takeover via touch, keyboard, or mixed input.
structure: S-10.2.123.1 — Reuse R09 takeover-panel overlay extended with a COMMAND TAKEOVER second-phase state: once the request is acknowledged, the panel's primary control enables to COMMAND TAKEOVER with a dual-input press-and-confirm gate accepting WAD Touch (tap select + tap confirm) and bezel OSS (discrete select + confirm) in any combination; in-panel connection-progress indicator (requesting→authorized→established) driven by aircraft acks; established-confirmation via reused R08 notification strip + R02-style audio ping.
structure_summary: Two-phase takeover panel with dual-input confirm gate
